title: NVIDIA Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Vera Rubin Ramp
summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) stock trades near $225, about 28.3 times its adjusted earnings over the past twelve months. Adjusted here means normalized net income with stock-based compensation added back, the same broad basis analysts use in their forecasts. For a stock near its 52-week high, that looks steep. But the multiple leaves out the growth analysts already expect, and that growth depends on how much NVIDIA can supply.
